call_points.text: EBITDA margin seen holding at about 9.3-9.4% annually; no expansion committed.
PAT margin guided at 7-7.5% for FY27.
Heavy-structure capacity to reach 40,000 tons by March-April next year and 60,000 tons by next November-December.
QIP approved but timing not fixed; funds mainly for the heavy-structure plant, finalised in two to three months.
Operating cash flow turned negative in FY26 on milestone-linked debtors and inventory build; expected to turn positive without a timeline.
Manpower shortage at construction sites named the biggest challenge for FY27.
Management remains confident of long-term growth backed by a strong order book of ₹1,703 Cr and capacity expansions.
Both the Andhra Pradesh heavy steel plant and Gujarat PEB facility are on track to be commissioned by Q2FY27.
The company maintains a debt-free status with strong net cash and robust equity reserves.
